hook.text: BP rebranded as 'Beyond Petroleum' in 2000 while spending 96% of its budget on fossil fuels.

buildup.text: Greenwashing uses environmental language to sell the appearance of sustainability without the substance.

discovery.text: BP also invented the 'personal carbon footprint' to shift climate blame from corporations to individual consumers.

twist.text: In 2010, the Deepwater Horizon spill killed 11 workers and spewed 210 million gallons of oil.

climax.text: Greenwashing shows that propaganda backfires when reality contradicts the message spectacularly.

punchline.text: Beyond Petroleum, then the worst oil spill in history. Copy can't hide reality.

quiz.question: What concept did BP invent to shift climate blame to consumers?
